notes.note: Scoped test-fixture review at 3f5e61ab6: the three standalone generated UI-server cases now bind OS-assigned loopback ports and obtain the real child's bound address over IPC. The observer forwards HTTP server creation unchanged and adds no production seam; bootstrap URL/nonce/CSP, proxy readiness and keepNames assertions remain. A real peer listener reproduced the queue's stderr assertion with EADDRINUSE (the hosted report itself truncated the errno). Initial repair passed all 235 lifecycle cases. From a committed clean tree, serializing the wrong API base made only the named nonce-bound bootstrap case fail its exact served-body assertion; 234 others passed, then production source was restored byte-identically. The referenced OAuth proxy exclusions, protocol/grant behavior and historical R3 evidence are unchanged. No new native-client, release-exposure or hosted-ingress qualification is claimed; no prose change required.
